policy: N3 single source: external numbers must come from this file. Every entry carries value + scope + date + reproducible command. scripts/check-metrics.cjs recomputes the git-derived entries and fails on drift.

tsr.files.scope: tracked RFC 3161 .tsr files, git ls-files (no dedupe)

tsr.uniqueTokens.scope: sha256 of each tracked .tsr blob, duplicates collapsed
tsr.uniqueTokens.command: for f in $(git ls-files '*.tsr'); do git show HEAD:$f | sha256sum; done | sort -u | wc -l

tsq.files.scope: tracked RFC 3161 .tsq files, git ls-files (no dedupe)

tsq.uniqueTokens.scope: sha256 of each tracked .tsq blob, duplicates collapsed
tsq.uniqueTokens.command: for f in $(git ls-files '*.tsq'); do git show HEAD:$f | sha256sum; done | sort -u | wc -l

tla.c2.distinct.scope: same run as tla.c2.generated; the pair must always be quoted together
